data: What is the highest value of the black line in the Sentiment graph?

The question asks for the highest value of the black line in the Sentiment graph. The Sentiment graph shows two lines, one black and one grey. The black line represents the sentiment trajectory. By visually inspecting the graph, the highest point of the black line appears to be around 0.25 on the y-axis. Therefore, the highest value of the black line in the Sentiment graph is approximately 0.25.
